title: Checkout service failures
description: The checkout endpoint started failing with 500 Internal Server Errors shortly after a deployment.

hypotheses.name: Incorrect payment endpoint
hypotheses.description: The latest deployment introduced an invalid payment API endpoint.
hypotheses.recommended_action: Compare the payment endpoint in version 1.8 with the last known-good version, and verify it against the provider's documented endpoint.

hypotheses.name: Payment provider outage
hypotheses.description: The external payment provider is unavailable or failing.
hypotheses.recommended_action: Engage payment gateway vendor support and trigger emergency fallback gateway routing.

hypotheses.name: Database failure
hypotheses.description: Database connectivity or queries are causing checkout failures.
hypotheses.recommended_action: Inspect PostgreSQL connection pool metrics and restart saturated read replicas if necessary.

evidence.observation: Checkout failures began at 10:05 UTC with connection refused to payment gateway host.
Database connections and queries are healthy (p99 latency < 4ms).
